correctness.rationale: The incidence derivatives follow from differentiating log F with N equal to the sum of all six state coordinates. Substitution into minus the Hamiltonian state gradient yields the six costates. A standalone finite-difference replay verifies every corrected state and control derivative. The recovered-costate omission and quarantine-adjoint mismatch also follow directly without numerical assumptions.

value.rationale: The correction changes the backward system that determines all three reported optimal controls. It is not a typographical normalization: the omitted state-dependence affects every costate through the incidence, and the quarantine term couples the susceptible costate to the wrong adjoint in print. This directly bears on reproducibility of the paper’s optimal-control conclusions.
